name: Abaco Boat Rental
brand_truth: One boat, done right: identical 24 ft Key Wests from Man-O-War Cay, delivered to your cay.
buyer: Families and friends staying a week on Elbow Cay, Hope Town, Guana Cay or Marsh Harbour (mostly US), booking on a phone.

design.signature: Sea of Abaco delivery chart coloured by fee, wired to a trip cost builder (days, delivery, add-ons) that sends a WhatsApp plan or opens the live booking page

current_site_findings: Homepage hero shows 'Unable to load video'
Empty homepage meta description; title is only the name
Homepage never says Man-O-War Cay; rates and delivery fees hidden on inner page
Rates page hero is an Unsplash stock photo
pitch_line: Your rates and delivery fees are clear but hidden a click away; this concept lets a family tap their cay, see the full price and send it to you on WhatsApp in thirty seconds.
assumptions: Cost estimate uses published rates, VAT excluded; snorkel sets priced at the 'from $5/day' floor
notes: Live Squarespace + Booqable site (2026), so pitch as conversion upgrade, not rescue. All prices, delivery fees, add-ons, hours and WhatsApp from their rates page. Guest quotes verbatim from their homepage (unnamed, labelled as from the current site). interact.mjs flags disabled '-' steppers at 0 and the range slider as dead; both work. Scorecard: hero 4, type 4, layout 4, context 5, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 5, consistency 4.
